summary.text: Karlton Howard is a Democratic state representative from Augusta who has represented Georgia House District 129 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor and Augusta native, he earned a bachelor's degree from LaGrange College.

paragraphs.text: Howard was born in and lives in Augusta, Georgia, and graduated from Lucy Craft Laney High School.
He earned a B.A. in business administration from LaGrange College and a certificate in theology from the Augusta branch of the American Baptist Theological Seminary.

His career experience includes working as pastor of the Noah's Ark Missionary Baptist Church in Keysville, Georgia, as a procurement specialist for the CSRA Business League in Augusta, and in the Howard family business.
Howard defeated Scott Cambers in the Democratic primary for House District 129 in 2024 and won the general election that year as the incumbent.
He defeated Cambers again in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary and is running in the general election.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education, Interstate Cooperation, and Public and Community Health committees.
